parsed.name: 参数控制模块
parsed.description: 用于实验控制软件中管理参数、响应设置变更，并通过 TCP/IP 或 LECO 与远端仪器或服务通信的通用控制模块。本证据不足以对应到某一台明确的物理实验设备。
parsed.description_en: A general control module used in laboratory control software to manage parameters, react to setting changes, and communicate with remote instruments or services over TCP/IP or LECO. The evidence does not support identification of a specific physical laboratory device.

actions.description: 处理用户在设置界面中修改参数时触发的事件。
actions.description_en: Handle events triggered when a user changes parameters in the settings interface.

actions.description: 通过 TCP/IP 连接远端仪器或服务。
actions.description_en: Connect to a remote instrument or service over TCP/IP.

actions.description: 连接或断开 LECO 通信客户端。
actions.description_en: Connect or disconnect the LECO communication client.

actions.description: 处理收到的 TCP/IP 状态或命令信息。
actions.description_en: Process received TCP/IP status or command information.
